// PROBE — compliant control for tests/unit/email-normalization-single-path.test.ts.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { normalizeEmail } from "@/lib/identity/normalize-email"

export async function addPhantom(rawEmail: string, name: string) {
    const email = normalizeEmail(rawEmail)
    let user = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { email } })
    if (!user) {
        user = await db.user.create({ data: { email, name, roles: "policyholder" } })
    }
    return user.id
}
